Fonts of the planner regression suite (`cli-anything-inkstitch regress`), all SIL Open Font License 1.1,
vendored unmodified:

- Lato-Black.ttf: Lato 2.0 (tyPoland), OFL-Lato.txt. The suite's sans lettering font.
- Lato-Regular.ttf: Lato from the Google Fonts repository (google/fonts, ofl/lato), OFL-Lato-Regular.txt.
- Lora[wght].ttf: Lora variable font (google/fonts, ofl/lora), OFL-Lora.txt; sewn at wght 400.
- GreatVibes-Regular.ttf: Great Vibes (google/fonts, ofl/greatvibes), OFL-GreatVibes.txt.

The last three are the same-family fonts used for the planner-versus-contender cases (`regress run --versus`).
Other suite fonts are referenced by path and skipped when absent.
